name.value: DeFi does not have an innovation problem. It has a vocabulary problem. Nearly every protocol ever shipped is a recombination of about fifty recurring mechanisms — and once you can name them, most of the industry stops looking novel and starts looking legible.

This is the one shape that goes to zero rather than merely down.

Name every recurring financial state transition and refuse everything
else. ERC-4626 is a socket, not a mechanism. A hook is somewhere to
put an element, not an element. “Points” is marketing. Most whitepapers
describe three real mechanisms and forty pages of scenery.
Parts are not chosen freely — each one drags in the next. Leverage
forces a truth source, a solvency test and a way for the position to end. A
protocol with leverage and only two of those three is not innovating. It is
missing a part, and you have just found it.
